arStrings.szText: Hits with {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} counts as Blocks. This effect can trigger once per Cast.

Whenever you have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} increases impact size by {c_number}[SF_9*100|%x|]{/c} and deals {c_number}{payload:SHIELDBASH_PAYLOAD_A}{/c} damage.

Gain {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} Resolve per enemy hit.

{c_important}Shield Bash{/c} smites the first enemy it hits, dealing {c_number}{payload:SHIELDBASH_PAYLOAD_MAIN_B}{/c} damage, Stunning for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADE_B_STUN}{/c} second, and Knocking Back enemies behind for {c_number}{payload:CHARGE_KNOCKBACK_B}{/c} damage.
Hits with {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} grant you {c_number}[SF_45|%+|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} Chance for {c_number}[SF_46]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[SF_44]{/c} times.
